content: Muddler documentation describes it as a Mudlet package builder that turns a root mfile plus src subdirectories into first-class Mudlet XML/package objects. The mfile owns package metadata including title/version/outputFile, src/scripts/aliases/triggers directories are scanned via JSON manifests, matching Lua filenames are used by convention with spaces converted to underscores, and @VERSION@/@PKGNAME@ tokens are replaced from the mfile. For boop, keep Muddler, preserve manifest load order, and add manifest/version parity gates rather than changing builders before 1.0.
